author: IGN
description:
Pinhead is, without a doubt, the image that first comes to mind when you hear the word Hellraiser. So when it was announced that Saber Interactive was turning the horror classic into a video game, there was no more important requirement than making sure they faithfully recreated the iconic Cenobite.

From brainstorming with Clive Barker to gameplay struggles, this is concept to controller: a detailed look at how Pinhead in Hellraiser: Revival came to life.
title: How Pinhead Was Created for Hellraiser: Revival - Concept to Controller

author: IGN
description:
Ah, the humble 7. The most infamous of all IGN scores. 7s are often overlooked and rarely end up on game of the year lists and best of lists and top 10s, etc. But not in this video! This one’s for the 7s. Let’s take a look at the very best games that were almost great -- the 7 Best 7s, if you will.

I’m going to break these lists down by era or genre or console. For this inaugural edition of the 7 best 7s I’m looking at the 2000s. 2000-2009, PlayStation 2 and 3, the Xbox and Xbox 360, Gamecube and the Nintendo Wii.

You’ve played some of these games. You probably even have good memories of playing some of these games. They’re good, but they’re not quite great. Let’s take a look back at the 7 best 7s: 2000s edition!
title: The 7 Best 7s: 2000s Edition

author: IGN
description:
**WARNING: Major Control Resonant spoilers ahead!**

The ending of **Control Resonant** raises some major questions about Jesse, Dylan, the Hedron, the Hiss, and the future of the FBC. In this video, we break down the ending, explain the storylines that lead up to it, and revisit the events of the original Control that are essential to understanding what happens. We’ll cover Jesse and Dylan’s childhood, the slide projector, Not-Mother, the FBC’s experiments, the Hedron, the Hiss, the final confrontation, and that mysterious epilogue. We’ll also dig into some of the game’s biggest unanswered questions and what they could mean.

#ign #gaming
title: Control Resonant Ending Explained
